topics.topic: Single-step two-state stock and derivative model

scope: Full official English caption text read sequentially; equations reconstructed and examples independently recomputed. No full audiovisual audit.
source_corrections: Risk-neutral valuation does not imply actual investor risk neutrality or equal physical expected returns.
The stock spot price does not uniquely identify physical probabilities.
Gross factors u and d are distinguished from percentage changes.
Strict no-arbitrage inequalities require both physical states possible.
Strikes outside the two terminal stock prices are legitimate and priced explicitly.
Root put intrinsic value is 2; option value is approximately 5.089632 on the exercise grid.
Annual-date early-exercise recursion does not examine continuous exercise between dates.
Source rounded figures replaced by independently reproduced full-precision arithmetic.
primary_checks: Cox-Ross-Rubinstein 1979 author manuscript sections2-3, pages3-7: state matching, usable short-sale proceeds, strict inequalities and pricing weights.
